news.summary: The 2026 Axonius Actionability Report found 12.7% of devices in a 298,000-device median inventory are missing expected security agents. IT and security professionals have long worked around gaps in agent reporting.
news.enterprise_use: Check your device inventory in your CMDB to spot stale or missing records. Inaction creates blind spots in SOC visibility and reconciliation. Most affected tool here is CMDB - use JumpCloud or other MDM platforms for inventory management.

news.title: Ire identifies another LOTUSLITE specimen
news.summary_raw:

news.summary: Ire detected LOTUSLITE malware through reverse engineering, outperforming EDR tools. This highlights AI-driven threat detection capabilities beyond traditional security tools.
news.enterprise_use: Check your EDR tool's configuration under detection settings; if you're missing LOTUSLITE detection, consider upgrading to an AI-enhanced solution or enable custom rules. Ignoring this may leave your organization vulnerable to stealthy malware attacks. JumpCloud or other SSO tools can aid in the discovery of suspicious user behavior in conjunction with an upgraded EDR tool.

news.title: Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis
news.summary_raw:
Talos was built to help resolve a major bottleneck in genomic medicine: human review time. The open-source system recovered 90% of in-scope diagnoses while surfacing just 1.3 candidate variants per patient for expert review. 
The post Talos: Scaling rare disease diagnosis with automated, iterative genomic reanalysis appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has built an open-source system called Talos, which uses automated genomic reanalysis to improve rare disease diagnosis, recovering 90% of in-scope diagnoses and identifying 1.3 candidate variants per patient for expert review. This could potentially transform clinical workflows with AI-assisted diagnosis.
news.enterprise_use: Low impact, but interesting to note. Note that this AI-assisted diagnosis is based on genomic reanalysis, which might not directly affect your IT infrastructure, but could inspire innovation in adjacent healthcare IT sectors.
